words_to_learn.definition_en: to negotiate; n., an advantageous purchase
words_to_learn.definition_vi: (v) mặc cả, thương lượng giá; (n) món hời, mặt hàng giá rẻ

examples.en: She bargained for over an hour, finally reducing the price by half.
examples.vi: Cô ấy đã mặc cả hơn một tiếng đồng hồ và cuối cùng giảm được một nửa giá.

examples.en: Lois compared the sweaters carefully to determine which was a better bargain.
examples.vi: Lois đã so sánh những chiếc áo len một cách cẩn thận để xác định xem chiếc nào là món hời tốt hơn.

structures: bargain with + sb + over/for + sth (mặc cả/thương lượng với ai về cái gì)
at a bargain price (ở mức giá hời)
usage.tip: Danh từ 'bargain' thường đi với tính từ 'good/great/real' (a great bargain = một món hời lớn) hoặc đứng trước 'price' (bargain prices).

extra_families.example: Tourists often bargain with street vendors at the local market.
At fifty percent off, this winter coat is an absolute bargain.
Another round of collective bargaining will begin next Monday.

srs_sentence.en: Shoppers arrived early in the morning to hunt for _____ during the annual clearance sale.
srs_sentence.vi: Người mua sắm đã đến từ sáng sớm để săn lùng những món hời trong đợt giảm giá xả kho thường niên.

words_to_learn.definition_en: to have tolerance for; to endure
words_to_learn.definition_vi: chịu đựng; gánh vác (chi phí/trách nhiệm)

examples.en: Moya doesn't like crowds so she cannot bear to shop during the holiday rush.
examples.vi: Moya không thích đám đông nên cô không thể chịu đựng được việc đi mua sắm vào dịp cao điểm lễ hội.

examples.en: If you can bear with me, I'd like to stop in one more store.
examples.vi: Nếu bạn có thể kiên nhẫn chờ tôi một chút, tôi muốn ghé thêm một cửa hàng nữa.

structures: bear with + sb (kiên nhẫn chờ/thông cảm cho ai)
bear in mind (that) (ghi nhớ rằng)
bear the cost/responsibility (chịu chi phí/trách nhiệm)
usage.tip: Trong TOEIC Listening và Reading, cụm lịch sự 'Please bear with us while we...' (Xin hãy kiên nhẫn chờ chúng tôi trong khi...) và 'bear the cost' (chịu chi phí) xuất hiện rất nhiều.

extra_families.example: The manufacturer agreed to bear the full cost of replacing the faulty parts.
This voucher entitles the bearer to a ten-dollar discount on any purchase.
Installing air conditioning made working in the warehouse much more bearable.
The noise from the adjacent construction site became unbearable by noon.

srs_sentence.en: Under the terms of the warranty, the buyer must _____ the shipping charges for returned merchandise.
srs_sentence.vi: Theo các điều khoản bảo hành, người mua phải chịu phí vận chuyển đối với hàng hóa trả lại.

words_to_learn.definition_vi: hành vi, cách cư xử, thái độ

examples.en: Annu is conducting a survey on whether consumer behavior differs between men and women.
examples.vi: Annu đang tiến hành một cuộc khảo sát xem liệu hành vi tiêu dùng có khác biệt giữa nam giới và nữ giới hay không.

examples.en: Suspicious behavior in a department store will draw the attention of the security guards.
examples.vi: Hành vi đáng ngờ trong cửa hàng bách hóa sẽ thu hút sự chú ý của các nhân viên bảo vệ.

structures: behavior toward + sb (cách cư xử đối với ai)
consumer/customer behavior (hành vi của người tiêu dùng)
usage.tip: Danh từ không đếm được, rất hay kết hợp thành cụm danh từ ghép 'consumer behavior / purchasing behavior' trong chủ đề Marketing & Purchasing.

extra_families.example: All representatives are expected to behave professionally at trade fairs.
Recent surveys show a shift in online shopping behavior.
The marketing firm analyzes behavioral data to predict seasonal trends.
Loyalty members differ behaviorally from occasional bargain shoppers.

srs_sentence.en: The research team used _____ analytics to understand how shoppers navigate the online store.
srs_sentence.vi: Nhóm nghiên cứu đã sử dụng phân tích hành vi để tìm hiểu cách người mua sắm điều hướng trên cửa hàng trực tuyến.

words_to_learn.definition_en: the act, time, or place of checking out, as at a hotel, library, or supermarket
words_to_learn.definition_vi: quầy thanh toán; thủ tục/giờ trả phòng (khách sạn)

examples.en: The line at this checkout is too long, so let's look for another.
examples.vi: Hàng người chờ ở quầy thanh toán này quá dài, vì vậy chúng ta hãy tìm một quầy khác.

examples.en: Get in the checkout line now and I'll join you with the last items.
examples.vi: Bạn cứ xếp hàng ở quầy thanh toán ngay bây giờ đi và tôi sẽ mang những món đồ cuối cùng ra chỗ bạn.

structures: at the checkout (counter) (tại quầy thanh toán)
checkout time (giờ trả phòng khách sạn)
usage.tip: Viết liền 'checkout' là danh từ (quầy thanh toán/thủ tục trả phòng), còn viết rời 'check out' là cụm động từ (thanh toán / trả phòng / kiểm tra).

extra_families.example: Hotel guests must check out before eleven o'clock in the morning.
Please present your discount coupon to the cashier at the checkout.

srs_sentence.en: Supermarket patrons with ten items or fewer may use the express _____ lane.
srs_sentence.vi: Khách hàng siêu thị mua từ mười món đồ trở xuống có thể sử dụng làn thanh toán nhanh.

words_to_learn.definition_en: to calm somebody; n., a condition or feeling of pleasurable ease, well-being, and contentment
words_to_learn.definition_vi: (n) sự thoải mái, sự tiện nghi; (v) an ủi, làm dịu lại

examples.en: Comfort yourself with a down quilt this winter.
examples.vi: Hãy tự mang lại sự ấm áp dễ chịu cho bản thân bằng một chiếc chăn lông vũ vào mùa đông này.

examples.en: I like to dress for comfort if I'm spending the day shopping.
examples.vi: Tôi thích ăn mặc sao cho thoải mái nếu phải dành cả ngày để đi mua sắm.

word_family.example: This car is designed with plush seats for your comfort and air bags for your safety.
I prefer this sweater because it's more comfortable.
I'd suggest buying the larger table, which comfortably seats six.

structures: dress for comfort (mặc đồ ưu tiên sự thoải mái)
travel in comfort (di chuyển một cách tiện nghi, thoải mái)
usage.tip: Họ từ này rất hay xuất hiện trong quảng cáo ghế văn phòng, khách sạn, giày dép và phương tiện vận chuyển (designed for your comfort / comfortably seats six).

extra_families.example: Employees complained that the old desk chairs were uncomfortable.

srs_sentence.en: The newly renovated airport lounge features _____ leather armchairs and complimentary Wi-Fi.
srs_sentence.vi: Phòng chờ sân bay mới được tân trang có những chiếc ghế bành bọc da êm ái và Wi-Fi miễn phí.

words_to_learn.definition_en: to increase the size, volume, quantity, or scope of; to enlarge

examples.en: The new manager has significantly expanded the store's inventory. a. The new manager has significantly expanded the store's inventory.
examples.vi: Người quản lý mới đã mở rộng đáng kể lượng hàng hóa lưu kho của cửa hàng.

examples.en: The shoe store is out of room and is thinking about expanding into the adjacent vacant building.
examples.vi: Cửa hàng giày đã hết chỗ và đang cân nhắc việc mở rộng sang tòa nhà trống liền kề.

word_family.example: The music store expanded its selection by offering more classical music on compact discs.

structures: expand + into + N (mở rộng sang thị trường/khu vực mới)
expand + O (mở rộng quy mô/danh mục sản phẩm)
usage.tip: Đi với giới từ 'into' khi nói về việc mở rộng hoạt động kinh doanh sang một thị trường, lĩnh vực hoặc mặt bằng mới (expand into Asia).

extra_families.example: The hotel suite offers an expansive view of the harbor.
The CEO spoke expansively about the company's five-year growth strategy.

srs_sentence.en: Following strong domestic sales, the apparel retailer announced plans for international _____.
srs_sentence.vi: Tiếp nối doanh số nội địa mạnh mẽ, nhà bán lẻ trang phục đã công bố kế hoạch mở rộng ra quốc tế.

words_to_learn.definition_vi: khám phá, tìm hiểu, thăm dò, khảo sát

examples.en: The collector likes to explore antique shops looking for bargains.
examples.vi: Nhà sưu tập thích dạo quanh khám phá các cửa hàng đồ cổ để tìm kiếm những món hời.

examples.en: While his mother shopped for clothes, Michael wandered off to explore the toy section.
examples.vi: Trong khi mẹ mua quần áo, Michael đã đi sang khám phá khu vực đồ chơi.

word_family.example: Ms. Marce explored the bins of hardware, looking for the right size nails.

structures: explore + possibilities/options/opportunities (tìm hiểu các khả năng/lựa chọn/cơ hội)
explore + ways to V (tìm kiếm các cách thức để làm gì)
usage.tip: Trong tiếng Anh thương mại, 'explore' thường mang nghĩa bóng là 'nghiên cứu, thăm dò' các phương án hoặc cơ hội hợp tác (explore business opportunities).

extra_families.example: Early market explorers often gain a strong competitive advantage.

srs_sentence.en: The two pharmaceutical companies held _____ discussions regarding a possible joint venture.
srs_sentence.vi: Hai công ty dược phẩm đã tổ chức các cuộc thảo luận thăm dò liên quan đến một liên doanh tiềm năng.

words_to_learn.definition_vi: món hàng, mặt hàng; mục, khoản

examples.en: The grocery store has a special checkout line for people who are purchasing fewer than ten items.

srs_sentence.vi: Vì mục đích thuế, vui lòng yêu cầu hóa đơn liệt kê chi tiết từng khoản từ quầy lễ tân khách sạn khi trả phòng.

part7.text: Questions 19–23 refer to the following article. Designing retail space takes careful planning. Attention should be paid to what research tells us about consumer behavior. Stores must be designed with the comfort of shoppers in mind. The aisles should be wide enough to allow shoppers to move through them comfortably. Items should be placed where they can be easily seen by shoppers. Nothing should be put on high shelves where it cannot be reached. Pleasant lighting and music also contribute to the comfort and good feeling of shoppers. Shoppers who feel happy and relaxed will make more purchases. When organizing the merchandise in a store, the trends of each season should be kept in mind. Picnic and beach equipment should be prominently displayed in the summer, for example, while warm clothing should be featured in the winter. Then, shoppers will return to the store because they will see it as a place that provides what they need. There should be plenty of checkout aisles so that long lines are avoided. Many people cannot bear long waits, and long checkout lines scare shoppers away from stores. Many stores are now using self-service checkout aisles, although they have not yet been completely accepted by shoppers. They are often confusing to use, and many shoppers find them impersonal. The old-fashioned human cashier is still popular in most retail outlets. Therefore, it is still considered mandatory for stores to have at least some full-service checkout lines manned by cashiers. When a store is properly designed, shoppers have a pleasant experience and will want to return. This helps the bottom line of the store owner which is, of course, increased sales. 23. The word bear in line 9 is closest in meaning to (A) tolerate (B) understand (C) refuse (D) decrease

_raw.words_to_learn:
## Shopping

Study the following definitions and examples.

1. bargain v., to negotiate; n., an advantageous purchase

a. She bargained for over an hour, finally reducing the price by half.

b. Lois compared the sweaters carefully to determine which was a better bargain.

2. bear v., to have tolerance for; to endure a. Moya doesn't like crowds so she cannot bear to shop during the holiday rush.

b. If you can bear with me, I'd like to stop in one more store.

3. behavior n., the manner of one's actions a. Annu is conducting a survey on whether consumer behavior differs between men and women.

b. Suspicious behavior in a department store will draw the attention of the security guards.

4. checkout n., the act, time, or place of checking out, as at a hotel, library, or supermarket

a. The line at this checkout is too long, so let's look for another.

b. Get in the checkout line now and I'll join you with the last items.

5. comfort v., to calm somebody; n., a condition or feeling of pleasurable ease, well-being, and contentment

a. Comfort yourself with a down quilt this winter.

b. I like to dress for comfort if I'm spending the day shopping.

6. expand v., to increase the size, volume, quantity, or scope of; to enlarge

a. The new manager has significantly expanded the store's inventory.

a. The new manager has significantly expanded the store's inventory.
b. The shoe store is out of room and is thinking about expanding into the adjacent vacant building.

7. explore v., to investigate systematically

a. The collector likes to explore antique shops looking for bargains.

b. While his mother shopped for clothes, Michael wandered off to explore the toy section.

8. item n., a single article or unit

a. The grocery store has a special checkout line for people who are purchasing fewer than ten items.

b. Do you think I can get all these items into one bag?

9. mandatory adj., required or commanded; obligatory a. The jewelry store has a mandatory policy of showing customers only one item at a time.

b. There is a mandatory limit of nine items for use of this checkout line.

10. merchandise n., items available in stores

a. I am very impressed with the selection of merchandise at this store.

b. Helen wanted to make sure that the store had a wide variety of merchandise before she committed to buying a gift certificate.

11. strictly adv., rigidly, without flexibility

a. Our store strictly enforces its return policy.

b. Their high turnover rate is no surprise, considering how strictly the manager deals with them.

12. trend n., the current style; vogue

a. The clothing store tries to stay on top of all the new trends.

b. Mioshi followed market trends closely before she bought a clothing franchise.

## Part 7 Reading Comprehension

Questions 19–23 refer to the following article.

Designing retail space takes careful planning. Attention should be paid to what research tells us about consumer behavior. Stores must be designed with the comfort of shoppers in mind. The aisles should be wide enough to allow shoppers to move through them comfortably. Items should be placed where they can be easily seen by shoppers. Nothing should be put on high shelves where it cannot be reached. Pleasant lighting and music also contribute to the comfort and good feeling of shoppers. Shoppers who feel happy and relaxed will make more purchases.

When organizing the merchandise in a store, the trends of each season should be kept in mind. Picnic and beach equipment should be prominently displayed in the summer, for example, while warm clothing should be featured in the winter. Then, shoppers will return to the store because they will see it as a place that provides what they need.

There should be plenty of checkout aisles so that long lines are avoided. Many people cannot bear long waits, and long checkout lines scare shoppers away from stores. Many stores are now using self-service checkout aisles, although they have not yet been completely accepted by shoppers. They are often confusing to use, and many shoppers find them impersonal. The old-fashioned human cashier is still popular in most retail outlets. Therefore, it is still considered mandatory for stores to have at least some full-service checkout lines manned by cashiers.

When a store is properly designed, shoppers have a pleasant experience and will want to return. This helps the bottom line of the store owner which is, of course, increased sales.
